title: wincase-c (variant C) NULL — rigging guard failed; single-task memory-win premise falsified (0 wins in 8)
summary: Phase 1 falsification of the cross-session winning-case experiment, variant C (real task→transcript resolveOwner). Built an honest anti-v4 trap: strategy-silent spec (bench/specs/wincase-c.md), programmatic 25-row acceptance fixture (bench/sandbox/wincase-resolve.test.js) where ~40% of rows have empty agent records recoverable ONLY by time-window overlap correlation against byWindow; naive direct+session impl fails 11 rows, correct correlation impl passes 29/0. Seeded note A (note-mq7kyiir6sx) verified as #1 semantic hit in workspace /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude. RIGGING GUARD FAILED: cold-B (arm off, no MCP) solved 3/3, each independently deriving the full window-correlation resolver by READING the committed test (mean H≈5805, W≈458, 3 explorers, ~40s). Trap is SELF-SOLVABLE → INVALID. Did NOT run the warm arm; NO win claimed. The single-task memory-win premise is FALSIFIED even under the most favorable authentic trap. Still 0 wins in 8 attempts (v1–v7 + wincase-c). ROOT CAUSE is structural: a committed, fully-specified acceptance test for a pure function leaves no empirical gap — the test IS the strategy reveal, so prose-silence can't create one. Fix paths: held-out (unreadable) test, a live-runtime-quirk task, or abandon single-task pure-function and pivot to multi-task/cross-session winning cases.
